goal: Ship AgentHandoff v0.1.0: capture a coding session once, export it to every AI agent's native context file

decisions.text: One source of truth in .agent-handoff/session.json, every output is generated from it
Call git through subprocess instead of a library
decisions.reason: keeps the core dependency-free and behaves like the user's own git

decisions.text: An adapter is data (target name -> path) plus one generic block writer
decisions.reason: adding an agent is a one-line change for a first-time contributor

decisions.text: Marker-delimited HTML comment block, replaced in place instead of appended
decisions.reason: exports stay idempotent and user text outside the block is safe

decisions.text: Atomic writes (temp file, fsync, os.replace) with newline disabled
decisions.reason: CRLF files stay CRLF and no half-written file is possible

decisions.text: English-only CLI output and README, Indonesian and English import labels
decisions.reason: global audience, the importer still accepts both

todos: Publish v0.1.0 to PyPI, then tag v0.1.0 and create the GitHub Release
Record the 15 second demo GIF from examples/demo.sh for the README
Open at least 5 good first issues (mostly agent adapter requests) before launch
Verify US-5 by hand with 3 real agents: goal, done and next steps answered from the exported file only
Launch on X, dev.to, Reddit and Show HN following docs/LAUNCH.md
v0.2: interactive init, status that reports per-agent sync state
done: core.py: Session dataclass, merge rules (done removes the matching todo, no duplicates), JSON storage, HANDOFF.md renderer
gitutil.py: branch, last commit, changed files, 10 recent commits, diff stat, safe in non-git folders and without a git binary
adapters.py: 7 export targets (claude, codex/agents, gemini, cursor, copilot, windsurf, markdown), aliases, --to all
cli.py: capture, export, show, status, import-log, scan-todos, init with --path/--quiet and readable errors
importer.py: log parser for English and Indonesian labels, TODO/FIXME scanner capped at 50 items
Test suite: 211 tests passing, about 94 percent coverage, ruff clean
Docs: README (English only), CONTRIBUTING, CHANGELOG, docs/FORMAT.md, docs/ROADMAP.md, docs/LAUNCH.md, docs/TESTING.md, examples
CI: ruff, 3 OS x Python 3.11/3.12/3.13, coverage gate, wheel build with clean-venv smoke test, dogfood job
Removed the Indonesian README and translated all user-facing output and docs to English
notes: This repo uses AgentHandoff on itself. After changing the session, run 'handoff export --to all' so the agent files at the repo root stay in sync. Manual verification steps live in docs/TESTING.md.
